statements.statement: The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation as the underlying etiology
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events
The service aims to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The study aims to guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate control management strategies
The denial reason code is CO-197
